screening.reason: Meets inclusion 2/3: analyses ABIDE I rs-fMRI connectivity data for a deep-learning-based ASD vs typical-control diagnostic classification.

evidence_spans.text:
The rs-fMRI data used in this study were sourced from
the ABIDE I dataset, comprising 505 autistic individuals and
530 typical controls (TCs).
evidence_spans.claim: Dataset was ABIDE I with 505 ASD and 530 TC subjects.

evidence_spans.text:
The data is preprocessed using the Conﬁgurable Pipeline for
the Analysis of Connectomes (CPAC) pipeline, which includes
essential steps such as slice timing correction, voxel intensity
normalization, motion correction, nuisance signal removal, global
signal regression, band-pass ﬁltering, and spatial registration.
evidence_spans.claim: Preprocessing used the CPAC pipeline with standard steps including motion correction.

evidence_spans.text:
After preprocessing and quality control, the ﬁnal dataset consists
of 1,035 samples distributed as follows: 623 samples for the
training set, 308 samples for the validation set, and 104 samples
for the test set.
evidence_spans.claim: After QC, 1,035 subjects were split into a single train/validation/test partition (623/308/104), with no cross-validation or site handling described.

evidence_spans.text:
Functional connectivity matrices are derived from three brain
atlases (AAL, CC, EZ) using Pearson correlation coeﬃcients, which
are ﬂattened into one-dimensional vectors.
evidence_spans.claim: Features are Pearson-correlation connectivity matrices from three atlases (AAL, CC, EZ).

evidence_spans.text:
Results: The proposed model is evaluated using multiple ASD datasets. The
performance metrics include an average accuracy of 0.735, sensitivity of 0.765,
and speciﬁcity of 0.752, surpassing the results of existing state-of-the-art
methods.
evidence_spans.claim: Average performance across the three atlas-based datasets: accuracy 0.735, sensitivity 0.765, specificity 0.752.

evidence_spans.text:
our developed
MHOA based on the SSDAE model has accuracy 66.35%, 70.19%,
and 83.82% for EZ, AAL, and CC, respectively.

Data availability statement
Publicly available datasets were analyzed in this study. This data
can be found here: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-022-
09821-6.
evidence_spans.claim: Data-availability statement links only to a general ABIDE-derived dataset reference, not a study-specific participant list or code.

assessments.support: N by diagnosis given (505 ASD/530 TC) and a post-QC total of 1,035 stated, but no explicit inclusion/exclusion rule or motion/QC threshold is described: "The rs-fMRI data used in this study were sourced from the ABIDE I dataset, comprising 505 autistic individuals and 530 typical controls (TCs)."
CPAC pipeline and three named atlases (AAL, CC, EZ) with Pearson-correlation connectivity matrices clearly described.
ASD/TC labels are the ABIDE phenotypic diagnosis, assigned independently of the imaging-derived predictors.

Single fixed train/validation/test split with no cross-validation or leave-site-out evaluation, and only point-estimate accuracy/sensitivity/specificity with no uncertainty reported: "the ﬁnal dataset consists of 1,035 samples distributed as follows: 623 samples for the training set, 308 samples for the validation set, and 104 samples for the test set."

risk_of_bias.summary: Pipeline and atlas choices are clearly reported, but cohort QC/exclusion detail is thin and evaluation relies on a single random train/validation/test split with no cross-validation or site handling.

charting.feature_extraction_tools: Configurable Pipeline for the Analysis of Connectomes (CPAC)
charting.specific_features: Pearson-correlation functional connectivity matrices using AAL, Craddock (CC) and EZ atlases
charting.model_category: Deep learning hybrid (Stacked Sparse Denoising Autoencoder + Multi-Layer Perceptron) with metaheuristic feature selection
charting.specific_algorithms: SSDAE-MLP hybrid with modified Hiking Optimization Algorithm (HOA with Dynamic Opposites Learning and Double Attractors) for feature selection
charting.validation_methodology: Single fixed train/validation/test split (623/308/104 of 1,035 samples); no cross-validation or leave-site-out evaluation reported
charting.key_performance_results: Average accuracy 0.735, sensitivity 0.765, specificity 0.752; per-atlas accuracy EZ 66.35%, AAL 70.19%, CC 83.82%
charting.dataset_openly_available: No study-specific participant list or code; data-availability statement only links to a general dataset reference

items.support: N by diagnosis and post-QC total given, but no explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria text.
QC mentioned generically, no metric/threshold given.
CPAC pipeline named with its steps.
ASD/TC labels are the ABIDE phenotypic diagnosis; this paper does not restate the diagnostic criteria used by ABIDE sites.
No statement that feature selection/autoencoder pre-training was confined to training data.
No site handling or leave-site-out evaluation; single pooled split.
No study-specific participant list or code.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction; ABIDE I, 505 ASD and 530 TC, post-QC total 1,035, split 623/308/104 train/validation/test, sites not itemised.
narrative_row.methods: CPAC-preprocessed rs-fMRI; Pearson-correlation connectivity matrices from AAL, CC and EZ atlases; SSDAE+MLP hybrid deep-learning classifier with a modified Hiking Optimization Algorithm for feature selection.
narrative_row.outcomes: Average accuracy 0.735, sensitivity 0.765, specificity 0.752 across the three atlas-based datasets; best per-atlas accuracy 83.82% (CC atlas).
narrative_row.key_limitations: Single fixed train/validation/test split with no cross-validation or site handling; no explicit leakage-control statement for feature selection/pre-training; no study-specific participant list or code.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Illustrates a deep-learning feature-selection approach on ABIDE I benchmarked against a prior published split strategy (Liu et al., 2024), but with limited reproducibility detail.

kg_link.cohort_description: 505 autistic individuals and 530 typical controls from ABIDE I, ages 10.0-35.0 (ASD) and 10.0-33.7 (TC); after preprocessing and quality control, final dataset of 1,035 samples.
kg_link.pipeline: CPAC (Configurable Pipeline for the Analysis of Connectomes)
